name: shipshape
description: Makes your coding agent work like a professional engineering team, and teaches you why: project memory loaded every session, no coding on guesses, risk tiers, branches and PRs, real-path tests, safe live changes, and an unattended mode that leaves a reviewable PR.

teaching.title: Teaching level
teaching.description: learning: explain each habit fully the first few times; working: a short why the first time; quiet: no teaching, same discipline.

git_guard.title: Commits on main/master
git_guard.description: What happens when Claude is about to commit or push on the default branch, and at session start when it finds itself there: ask you, block it, or do nothing.

auto_setup.title: Set up project memory
auto_setup.description: When a project has no memory docs yet: ask once (ask), set it up on a branch without asking (auto), or never (off).
